content.text:
对内地游客来说，在澳门点外卖首选 **澳觅 App（AOMI）**：支持 **+86 内地手机号注册、微信/支付宝支付、中文界面**，也有小程序；除了餐饮外卖，还能买便利店/超市闪购、团购餐券等，游客适配度最高。到酒店前可先装好并注册，定位后看配送范围和预计时间。

其他选择可以作为补充：
- **foodpanda**：国际平台，部分区域餐厅选择较多，适合英文/葡语界面或已有账号的用户；支付方式以结算页为准。
- **闪锋/澳门本地配送平台**：个别餐厅或同城配送可能覆盖，但通用性通常不如澳觅。
- 酒店餐厅可直接看酒店官方小程序、微信公众号或客房送餐，部分度假村有自有点餐渠道。

实用提醒：澳门酒店外卖大多只能送到 **酒店大堂、礼宾部或指定取餐点**，一般不能送到房间；地址要写清酒店全称、楼栋/塔楼和入口，并保持手机畅通。若收不到澳觅短信，可检查漫游、区号 +86，或尝试微信小程序/微信登录。付款前以结算页显示的微信支付、支付宝等选项为准，留意澳门币汇率和配送费。

annotations.title: 去澳门旅游住酒店，怎么点外卖?内地手机号能不能用、送到哪里取_配送_App_订单
annotations.summary:
去澳门旅游住酒店，怎么点外卖？内地手机号能不能用、送到哪里取
莫伊拉
2026-10-13 15:12
今年国庆假期，澳门7天入境旅客114.3万人次，10月4日单日达21.0万人次，酒店平均入住率91.3%（澳门旅游局 2026-10-08 公布的初步数据）。11月19日至22日还有第73届澳门格兰披治大赛车，赛事周末前后酒店同样会很满。人多的时候，旅游区餐厅排队久，不少人干脆回酒店叫外卖。
没有澳门电话卡能不能注册、地址怎么填骑手才找得到、能不能送到房间——这几个问题最常见。按操作顺序说明如下。
一、注册：内地手机号一般可用
澳门本地常用的外卖平台之一是澳觅（AOMI），2016年上线，外卖、团购、超市闪购和游客服务都在同一个 App 里。按澳觅帮助中心的说明，内地旅客一般不需要另办澳门电话卡：注册时区号选 +86（中国大陆），输入内地手机号、接收短信验证码即可；香港手机号选 +852。前提是手机已开通漫游，在澳门能正常收短信。
收不到验证码时，先核对区号和号码，再重新获取；页面支持的话也可以用微信账号登录。外国游客如果没有内地、香港或澳门号码，可以买一张澳门临时电话卡，或者直接在微信里搜「澳觅外卖」小程序下单。小程序能满足基本的浏览和下单，看配送进度、联系骑手等功能 App 更完整。
验证码只用于登录，不要告诉任何人，包括自称骑手、商户或客服的人。
二、地址：写全名称、楼栋和取餐点
澳门很多酒店同时有中文、英文、葡文名称，同一个综合度假区里还可能有好几栋楼、好几个入口，地址写得笼统，骑手很容易绕路。下单时建议：
1. 打开 App 允许定位，或者手动搜索酒店名称，确认页面显示的商户能配送到这个位置。2. 收货信息写全：酒店完整名称（最好中英文都写）、详细地址、所在楼栋或塔楼、能接通的手机号。3. 配送备注写清取餐位置，比如「XX酒店 主大堂礼宾台」或「XX塔 地面层入口」。4. 结算前看一遍商品规格、配送费、优惠后的实付金额和预计送达时间。
三、取餐：多数要到大堂或指定区域
一般不能指望送到房门口。澳门大多数酒店只允许在大堂或指定区域交收，能不能上楼由酒店规定和现场安排决定。比较稳妥的做法是：下单后留意订单页的配送状态，快到时提前下楼；不确定交收点在哪里，可以先问前台或礼宾，再写进备注。
四、付款：以结算页实际选项为准
结算页常见的有支付宝、微信支付、银联云闪付、VISA/MasterCard 信用卡，以及 MPay、支付宝（澳门）等本地钱包。不同账户、设备和订单显示的选项会不一样，以结算页为准。内地游客用支付宝或微信付款时，扣款通常按当时汇率折算成人民币。
五、售后：订单页或「我 > 在线客服」
下单后在「订单」页能看到商户接单、备餐和配送的实时状态。餐品有问题或迟迟没送到，先打开对应订单，看有没有「客服」「售后」或「申请退款」入口；没有的话走「我 > 在线客服」。
六、同 App 还可团购、闪购
同一个 App 里还有团购（自助餐订座、餐厅套餐券、景点和演出票务）、超市和便利店的闪购配送，以及面向游客的充电宝等服务，2024年起客户端支持英文模式。酒店自助餐、节日套餐这类团购，建议先确认是否需要预约再安排行程。大赛车周末想看比赛又不想挤餐厅，可以提前买好附近餐厅的团购券，或者回酒店点外卖。
出发前把 App 装好、注册完成，到了澳门打开定位看看酒店附近有哪些商户能送，第一顿就不用临时找路了。
 
本文作者：莫伊拉

annotations.summary:
第一次来澳门旅游，想点外卖，很多内地游客都会问：微信、支付宝在澳门能不能用？还需要准备现金吗？其实澳门目前有多种电子支付方式。对内地游客来说，比较常见的包括： 澳门常见电子支付方式微信支付｜支付宝｜MPay｜银联/银行卡其中，微信支付和支付宝对内地游客来说比较熟悉；MPay（澳门钱包）则是澳门本地常用的电子支付工具。如果来澳门旅游，建议至少准备一种常用电子支付方式，同时保留银行卡作为备用。不过要特别注意：不同平台、商户和订单支持的支付方式可能不同，具体能使用哪一种，请以实际订单结算页面显示为准。 内地游客点外卖，为什么推荐澳覓？如果来澳门想点外卖，可以提前下载澳覓APP。澳覓从餐饮外卖起步，目前除了外卖到家，还覆盖：️ 到店团购 闪购到家 同城配送 游客零售及部分本地生活服务平台早已与微信支付全球、支付宝等支付平台合作，并通过小程序等方式为来澳游客提供本地生活服务。实际点餐也很简单：打开澳覓 → 搜索餐厅 → 选择商品 → 填写配送信息 → 进入结算 → 查看可用支付方式 → 完成付款。⚠️ 第一次来澳门，支付时注意4件事① 付款前确认支付方式不要默认所有订单都支持同一种支付方式，以当前订单结算页面为准。② 注意订单金额和币种澳门消费通常以澳门元（MOP）计价，付款前确认最终订单金额，避免因为汇率或支付渠道产生误解。③ 优惠活动看清使用条件外卖优惠、团购优惠可能有相应使用规则，结算前确认一下。④ 建议准备备用支付方式如果一种支付方式临时无法使用，可以更换其他可用方式。 为什么更推荐澳覓？如果只是点一顿外卖，可以根据餐厅、价格、优惠和配送时间来选择。但对于来澳门旅游的内地游客来说，澳覓的优势不仅是外卖，还可以把吃饭、团购、即时零售、配送以及部分游客消费需求放在同一个平台里解决。据了解，目前平台拥有5,700+合作商户、300万+注册用户，覆盖澳门多个本地消费场景。所以第一次来澳门旅游，建议提前把澳覓APP下载好，内地86号码支持一键注册。点外卖的时候方便，想找团购、买日用品或者了解澳门本地生活服务，都可以直接在APP里查询，功能还是蛮齐全的 
本文作者：黄琥珀

The Macau food delivery platform market exhibits clear regional variations. foodpanda covers over 90% of all dining establishments across Macau, with a concentration in the northern district of the Macau Peninsula and the old town area of Taipa; Uber Eats focuses on high-end hotels and shopping mall restaurants along the Cotai Strip; local platforms such as Macau Companion and Miehe have deeply cultivated community markets, covering traditional residential areas like Fai Chi Kei and São Lourenço. According to 2025 data, Taipa district accounts for 35% of all food delivery orders in Macau, while Cotai accounts for 28%, reflecting a clear distinction between tourist and resident consumption patterns.
Delivery area differences among platforms also impact user experience. Delivery within the Macau Peninsula urban area can typically be achieved within 30 minutes, while remote areas of Coloane generally require 45 minutes or more. If located along the Cotai Strip, Uber Eats offers a richer selection of restaurants; in traditional communities such as São Lourenço and Fai Chi Kei, foodpanda and local platforms have more apparent advantages. Users are advised to select their primary platform based on regional characteristics and use other platforms as alternatives.
When selecting a platform, consider the following strategies: first, confirm whether the delivery address falls within the platform's service area; second, compare the presence of frequently-used restaurants; finally, pay attention to promotional activity periods for each platform. By adopting this approach, optimal food delivery experiences can be obtained across different areas. For detailed restaurant recommendations for each platform, refer to the special topics on foodpanda, Uber Eats, and other platforms.
foodpanda vs Uber Eats vs Local Platform Fee Structure Comparison
The fee structures of Macau's food delivery platforms show significant differences, and merchants can choose the most suitable partnership model based on their positioning. According to 2025 market data, foodpanda charges restaurants a commission rate of approximately 18% to 25%, with new merchants receiving a preferential rate of 15% for the first three months, and delivery fees ranging from 8 to 15 Macau Patacas per order, depending on distance.
Uber Eats has a relatively straightforward commission structure, with a standard rate of 30%, but offers higher visibility and international user traffic. The base delivery fee starts at 10 Macau Patacas, with an additional 5 to 8 Macau Patacas for distances exceeding 3 kilometers, making it suitable for high-end hotel restaurants and shopping mall food outlets. It is worth noting that Uber Eats has stricter verification standards for merchants, requiring complete business registration and food hygiene licenses.
The advantages of local platforms 澳覓 and 米盒 lie in their low commission rates, averaging only 12% to 18%, and their flexible payment options for small to medium-sized neighborhood restaurants. 澳覓 charges a delivery fee of 5 to 12 Macau Patacas per order, while 米盒 offers free delivery in specific areas (such as Ilha Verde and Madre de Deus).
Cost Optimization Recommendations: If a merchant is located in the Cotai Strip area and targets high-end customers, Uber Eats' international user base can provide additional visibility; if focusing on neighborhood resident business, 澳覓 or 米盒's low commission strategy offers better cost efficiency; foodpanda is suitable for comprehensive restaurants seeking to cover diverse customer segments across Macau.
Restaurant Settlement Costs and Operational Pain Points (B2B Perspective)
The fee structure of Macau's food delivery platforms significantly impacts restaurant profit margins. According to 2025 market data, foodpanda charges restaurants a commission rate of approximately 18% to 25%, with new merchants receiving a preferential rate of 15% for the first three months, and delivery fees ranging from MOP 8 to 15 per order depending on distance; Uber Eats has a standard rate of 30%, but offers higher visibility and international user traffic; local platforms like Ao Life offer more flexible commission structures, with some using monthly subscription fees instead of per-order commissions, which is more beneficial for high-volume merchants.
Beyond explicit fees, restaurants face multiple operational pain points. First, cross-platform order integration is challenging—managing the backend systems of foodpanda, Uber Eats, and local platforms simultaneously often leads to dish preparation sequence confusion and customer complaints. Second, platforms have strict requirements for menu photos, with professional photography costing approximately MOP 500 to 1,500 per set. Third, production capacity is limited during peak hours, and conflicts between delivery orders and dine-in service lead to quality degradation.
Recommendations for Restaurants: (1) Calculate the actual net revenue from each platform before deciding on a primary channel, rather than blindly listing on all channels; (2) Design delivery-specific menus, replacing lower-margin side dishes with higher-profit items; (3) Consider using third-party order integration systems like Toast or Square, which cost an additional MOP 200 to 500 per month but can significantly reduce human errors. Many Portuguese restaurants and tea shops in Macau have adopted this strategy, increasing their delivery revenue share to 35%-40% of total income.
If restaurants wish to further optimize operational efficiency, refer to Takeaway Packaging Solutions or Kitchen Equipment Procurement Guide to reduce packaging costs and dish preparation time.

In terms of time slots, the lunch peak period runs from 11 AM to 1 PM, accounting for approximately 35% of daily orders, with Chinese fast food and light meals being the main categories. Although late-night orders (10 PM to 2 AM) represent only 12% of total volume, the average order value exceeds 120 MOP, with congee, desserts, and sweet soup shops performing exceptionally well. It is worth noting that food delivery orders in Macau are approximately 20% higher on Wednesdays through Fridays compared to weekends, reflecting the local residents' reliance on food delivery during weekdays.
